evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: Zip Slip protections implemented in CVE-2023-24057 (GHSA-jqh6-9574-5x22) can be bypassed due to a partial path traversal vulnerability. In TerminologyCacheManager.java, `String path = Path.of(Utilities.path(targetDir, ze.getName())).normalize().toFile().getAbsolutePath();` -- while getAbsolutePath returns a normalized path, because the string path is not slash terminated, the guard `path.startsWith(targetDir)` can be bypassed to write the contents of the Zip file to a sibling directory of the cache directory. Consider "/usr/outnot".startsWith("/usr/out").
